measurement_notes.ttft: Wall time through receipt of the first generated token; includes prompt prefill, first-token model work, and sampling.
measurement_notes.decode: Wall time after the first response through the final response.
measurement_notes.measured_decode_tps: Generated-token transitions after the first token divided by decode wall time.
measurement_notes.inter_token_latency: Wall-clock intervals between successive streamed token responses.

conclusion_inputs.profiling_gate: A phase is dominant when its median share is at least 50%. A custom-kernel experiment requires a Metal trace to identify an operation family with enough end-to-end share for a plausible 10% win.
